intro: This Refund Policy applies to all orders placed with ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD ('Company,' 'we,' 'us,' or 'our'), a private limited company registered in England and Wales (Company Number: 17474730; Registered Office: Office 1878 85 Dunstall Hill, Wolverhampton, WV6 0SR, United Kingdom). Because our services involve custom product procurement and international order fulfillment coordinated specifically to each customer's requirements, refund eligibility depends on the stage at which a cancellation or issue arises. Please read this policy carefully before placing an order.

sections.heading: Pre-Procurement Cancellations — Full Refund
sections.body: If a customer cancels an order before ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD has commenced procurement activities — that is, before any products have been sourced, ordered, or committed to on the customer's behalf — the customer is entitled to a full refund of any amounts paid. To request a pre-procurement cancellation, the customer must contact us in writing at support@arseenenterprises.co.uk as soon as possible after placing the order. We will confirm whether procurement has commenced and, if it has not, process the refund within ten (10) business days. Refunds are returned to the original payment method used at the time of purchase.

sections.heading: Post-Procurement Cancellations — No Refund
sections.body: Once ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD has commenced procurement activities — including sourcing, ordering, committing to, or paying for products on the customer's behalf — the order cannot be cancelled and no refund will be issued. This applies regardless of whether the goods have been dispatched. Because products are procured specifically to each customer's requirements, procurement costs are incurred at the time of sourcing and cannot be recovered by ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD upon cancellation. Customers are encouraged to review their requirements carefully before approving a quotation and making payment.

sections.heading: Orders in Transit — No Refund
sections.body: Once an order has been dispatched and is in transit with an independent logistics provider, no refund or cancellation is available. Customers may contact us at support@arseenenterprises.co.uk for shipment-status support. If a parcel is returned to us by the carrier due to an incorrect address, failed delivery attempts, or refusal of delivery by the recipient, the customer will be responsible for any re-shipment costs. Refunds are not issued for returned parcels unless the return was caused by an error on the part of ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD.

sections.heading: Defective, Damaged, or Incorrect Goods
sections.body: If goods arrive materially defective, damaged in transit, or substantially different from the product specifications confirmed in the written quotation, the customer must notify ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD in writing at support@arseenenterprises.co.uk within seven (7) calendar days of the confirmed delivery date. The notification must include: (a) a clear description of the defect, damage, or discrepancy; (b) photographic evidence of the goods and packaging as received; and (c) the order reference number. Upon receipt and review of a valid claim, ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD will, at its discretion, offer one of the following remedies: (i) replacement of the affected goods, subject to availability; (ii) a partial or full credit note applicable to a future order; or (iii) a partial or full refund, where a replacement or credit is not practicable. Claims submitted after the seven (7) day notification window, or without the required documentation, may not be accepted.

sections.heading: Non-Refundable Fees and Charges
sections.body: The following fees and charges are non-refundable under all circumstances: (a) service fees for procurement coordination, order management, and fulfillment administration already incurred; (b) international freight, courier, and logistics charges paid to independent carriers; (c) customs duties, import taxes, and government assessments levied by customs authorities; (d) payment-processing fees charged by payment providers; (e) inspection, quality-control, and documentation fees already incurred; and (f) packaging and handling charges already applied. These charges represent costs incurred by ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD on the customer's behalf and cannot be recovered upon cancellation or return.

sections.heading: Customs Delays and Delivery Failures
sections.body: ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD does not issue refunds for delays caused by customs clearance, security inspections, carrier congestion, weather events, public holidays, remote-area delivery, or other circumstances outside our reasonable control. All delivery periods communicated to customers are estimates, not guarantees. If a parcel is held, seized, or destroyed by customs authorities due to the nature of the goods, applicable import restrictions, or inaccurate information provided by the customer, no refund will be issued and the customer may be liable for any associated costs.

sections.heading: Refund Process and Timelines
sections.body: Approved refunds are processed within ten (10) business days of the date on which ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD confirms the refund in writing. Refunds are returned to the original payment method used at the time of purchase. The time for a refund to appear in the customer's account depends on the payment provider and financial institution and is outside our control. ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD will provide written confirmation of any approved refund, including the amount and the expected processing timeline.

sections.heading: How to Request a Refund
sections.body: To request a refund or raise a dispute, please contact ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD in writing at support@arseenenterprises.co.uk with the subject line 'Refund Request — [Your Order Reference]'. Include your full name, order reference number, the reason for the refund request, and any supporting documentation. We will acknowledge your request within two (2) business days and provide a decision within ten (10) business days of receiving all required information.

sections.heading: Consumer Rights — UK Customers
sections.body: Nothing in this Refund Policy limits or excludes any statutory rights you may have under applicable UK consumer protection legislation, including the Consumer Rights Act 2015 and the Consumer Contracts (Information, Cancellation and Additional Charges) Regulations 2013. Where goods are supplied to a consumer (not a business) and are found to be faulty, not as described, or not fit for purpose, the consumer may have additional statutory remedies including the right to a repair, replacement, or refund. If you believe your statutory rights apply to your situation, please contact us at support@arseenenterprises.co.uk and we will assess your claim accordingly.

sections.heading: Policy Updates
sections.body: We reserve the right to update this Refund Policy at any time to reflect changes in our business practices, legal requirements, or service offerings. Material changes will be communicated via a notice on our website. Your continued use of our services after any update constitutes acceptance of the revised policy. For questions about this policy, contact us at support@arseenenterprises.co.uk.
